before_evaluation.answer_quote: If fewer eligible residents claim the reserved blocks than are reserved, every unclaimed reserved block returns immediately to the general Open Pool draw for that block or, if the general draw has already occurred, to the standby instant-fill queue; no reserved block is held unused.
before_evaluation.conclusion: The BEFORE position answers the existence and no-holding half of the question but not the ticket-rule interaction half; it therefore only partially decides the question and leaves a gap about how returned blocks are allocated.
before_evaluation.derivation: The BEFORE answer commits to immediate return and no held reserved block, but it does not state the ticket weights or queue rule under which a returned block is allocated. That leaves the return interaction with the Open Pool lottery underspecified for an understandable, challengeable rule set.
